projects.name: Audithole
projects.description: A honeypot framework and fingerprinting system, plugin-first and built to connect with your automation and tooling. Deployed on infrastructure you own, so you see exactly who is crawling you - and catch the ones pretending to be visitors.

projects.name: Coreforge
projects.tagline: Site rig: landing shell, docs rig, CI plumbing
projects.description: One repo, two sites, zero styling drift. This is the rig half of a site: the landing shell, the docs rig, and the CI/release plumbing. This repo is a tracked template. Formerly known as flowforge.

projects.name: Crashtest
projects.description: In-process adversarial QA for agent-built software. A seeded attack suite runs against your real handlers through a fake transport, producing a hardening ledger your CI fails on regressions. No network, no bans, no invoice. We break it so they cannot.

projects.name: Creadev QoS
projects.description: Quality-of-service primitives published as @creadev.org/qos on npm. Retry with backoff, hard timeouts, circuit breakers, and typed HTTP utilities - the resilience layer our services share, so flaky upstreams become boring instead of fatal.

projects.name: Creadev Security
projects.description: The security toolkit behind Creadev projects, published as @creadev.org/security on npm. Rate limiting, input sanitization, WAF rules, and validation in one shared package - the same guards we ship on our own production surfaces, extracted so every project gets them.

projects.name: Eyestruct
projects.description: Eyes for production agents. Deterministic capture (look), pixel-level change comparison (diff), and a committed visual memory (.eyes/) that CI can gate - the crashtest ledger pattern aimed at appearance instead of attackability.

projects.name: Freestruct
projects.description: Run one command after any static site generator, Jekyll, Hugo, Astro, you name it, and every page gets missing-only SEO: title, description, canonical, Open Graph, Twitter, and JSON-LD, plus an aggregated sitemap with per-page lastmod, robots.txt, an RSS feed, a noindex 404, cache-busted assets, and link validation. Sub-path installs included. No plugins, no template edits.

projects.name: Gamestruct
projects.tagline: One semantic tree, two lanes: a11y and agents
projects.description: One semantic tree that serves both a human on assistive technology and a machine agent, because they need the same thing: named, role-tagged nodes with stable handles, a linear traversal, and an event stream. Describe the surface once, and the human lane renders it for screen readers, switch and voice control, and the agent lane renders it for MCP clients and scripted tests. Four primitives (observe, act, wait_for, events), two lanes, one contract. Born in games, but any surface with a door qualifies, including a terminal host that runs the human lane over SSH.

projects.name: Gistory
projects.description: A secure, privacy-first prompt keeper for AI workflows. Write prompts with variable templates, organize with tags, projects, and forked variants, and sync across your devices end-to-end encrypted. No account required, data stays on device. The sync engine is packaged separately as gistory-sync: E2EE push/pull, pure merge rules, QoS scheduling, and a storage seam that runs anywhere.

projects.name: Govstruct
projects.tagline: Controller layer for a family of repos
projects.description: The controller layer of the struct family. One manifest of members, one render surface per deployment shape, one doctor verb that verifies every adopter serves the same truth. The crosslink mesh - the apps menu, the README tables, the status registry - stops being hand-typed N times and becomes governed data with teeth. Zero dependencies.

projects.name: Memstruct
projects.tagline: One memory record format and merge contract
projects.description: A memory standard for all. Every memory system invents its own record shape and its own merge, so moving memory between two of them is a rewrite every time. Memstruct is the interchange that ends it: one record format, one normative merge contract, and a zero-dependency CLI that lints a store, merges two of them with last-write-wins plus tombstones, and audits the merge against a conformance suite. Refuse the envelope, carry the body, so an unknown field is data instead of a violation. It does not compete with git or MCP, it is the record grammar that rides them.

projects.name: Migrare
projects.description: A migration tool that detects lock-in signals in projects generated by Lovable, Bolt.new, Replit, and v0 (Vercel), then applies automated transforms to hand you a clean, portable, self-owned codebase. Out of the walled garden, into the infrastructure you actually control.

projects.name: Monoforge
projects.tagline: Fleet repo factory: stamp, doctor, lock
projects.description: Monoforge is the factory that stamps fleet repos from proven blocks, doctors them for truth, and locks them verifiably. One zero-dependency CLI, three verbs: new (stamp), doctor (truth battery), lock (archive + checksum). One law holds it together: generated green is never shipped, because a shipped placeholder is a shipped lie.

projects.name: Packstruct
projects.description: Packstruct: a shared /packs spec. One manifest, entry, and lifecycle contract for runtime/ci mitigation packs - plus a zero-dependency lint CLI that kills broken pack manifests at author time.

projects.name: Poststruct
projects.tagline: Post-build HTML auditor for any generator
projects.description: Poststruct audits what shipped. A zero-dependency CLI that walks a directory of baked HTML, any generator output, and verifies it against a head/site contract: SEO hygiene, link integrity, i18n, accessibility-lite, feeds. FAIL findings exit non-zero, so CI gates the regression.

projects.name: Prestruct
projects.description: Build-time SEO prerendering for Vite + React apps on Cloudflare Pages. One command validates your config, bakes per-route HTML, Schema.org, OG, and an aggregated sitemap, re-renders only what changed, and handles 301 redirects and CDN caching. Optional render islands, a bot-render proxy, and build-time CMS routes. This site runs on it.

projects.name: Regarded
projects.description: An experimental KISS/DRY crypto trading bot platform that executes paper and live trades from technical indicators and custom rulesets, built for the Cloudflare free tier. Multi-exchange connectors for Kraken, Solana, and Jupiter, a multi-timeframe rules engine with chaining and risk modifiers, plus psychology guards, position sizing, and daily loss limits. Full paper trading simulation before a single live order. 359 tests. Use at your own risk.

projects.name: Stegoframe
projects.description: An experimental codec for encoding encrypted payloads (messages) inside SVG or PNG image carriers. Stegoframe enables covert communication channels for both humans and machines. Messages hidden in plain sight.

projects.name: Synmergia
projects.description: A free and open source MMORPG built on one real sphere. The hills, the rivers, the tides, and the sky all agree with each other, so the world still makes sense wherever you stand, and it runs in the browser with no download. Action combat with dodge, parry, and positioning, a player-driven economy with gathering, crafting, player housing, and guild territory, plus full-loot PvP and guild wars where death has weight. Built in Godot 4 and exported to the browser over WebAssembly, with an authoritative server behind it. AI agents can join the world alongside human players.

projects.name: This
projects.tagline: A ROM Spec for Agent Runtimes
projects.description: A .this root folder ROM spec for booting any agent runtime. The folder travels with the repository, so what an agent needs at boot comes from the repo itself, not from a platform. Spec first, runtimes welcome.

projects.name: Vant
projects.tagline: The Agentic OS - Memory, Runtime & Evolution
projects.description: An operating system for AI agents. Memory files live in your own repository - the agent reads them when it wakes and writes what it learned when it sleeps, so git history becomes the memory lineage. Three memory systems: markdown brain files, a key-value store, and semantic brain search - plus cold storage and a runtime, all over MCP, so any agent on any stack can use it. Stop using Vant and the memory is still there, readable with cat.

projects.name: Threadforge
projects.description: A platform for analyzing Reddit communities and scheduling posts, either manually or with AI assistance. Built for marketers, community managers, and power users who need real insight and reliable, rules based automation. Triggers thought out from the start.

projects.name: Weisync
projects.description: BETA - Invite Only: A platform that brings Git workflows to a clean, visual interface. No terminal or app required. Weisync lets developers and non-developers alike perform repository operations through a web interface. Import/export, clone, sync, merge, revert, purge, and more in a single web workflow. You finally found it.

projects.name: Vibe Flow Festival
projects.description: Full web presence for Vibe Flow Festival, a three-day flow arts, fire, and music gathering at Kinzua Heritage Grounds on June 19-21, 2026. We designed and built the site and run the back-end business operations behind it: email infrastructure and operational tooling. Ticketing runs through Eventbrite.
